summary: Adds a stroke halo to impact-map band labels and row headers so edges can run behind them, and documents the new paint order in diagram.md.

candidates.claim: `.band ~ .hdr` halos every row header in `--bg`, but only `.band-l.ctx` is overridden to `--sheet`; a row header inside a `band ctx` (no fill, so the sheet shows) keeps the `--bg` halo.
candidates.bad_outcome: Row headers inside a context band render on a visible --bg pill against the --sheet background (#F3F4F7 on #FFFFFF light, #0E1014 on #161920 dark).
evidence: skills/quality/impact-map/rules/diagram.md:20 (every band's rows headed by an hdr label)
candidates.fix: Extend the ctx override to `.hdr.ctx`, and say in diagram.md that a ctx band's row headers take `ctx` too.
candidates.verify_by: Read page.html:90-103 for the ctx background and the halo selectors; read diagram.md:20 and :34 for whether ctx-band rows carry hdr labels.
candidates.title: Row headers in a context band get the wrong halo
candidates.body: `.band ~ .hdr` gives every row header a `--bg` halo, but a `band ctx` has no fill, so its headers sit on `--sheet` and show a visible pill. Only `.band-l.ctx` is overridden.

candidates.claim: The new paint order puts row headers after edges, but the Skeleton (diagram.md:77-78) still paints the `hdr` label before the edges.
candidates.bad_outcome: A banded diagram copied from the Skeleton paints edges over row headers, the case the halo exists to fix.
candidates.fix: Move the Skeleton's `hdr` line below the edges comment so both blocks show one paint order.
candidates.verify_by: Read diagram.md:32 and diagram.md:70-90 and compare the two orders.
candidates.title: Skeleton still paints row headers before edges
candidates.body: The new paint order puts row headers after edges, but the Skeleton still paints `hdr` first. A banded diagram copied from it draws edges over its headers.

gate1.details: The description matches what the diff does.

gate5.details: The change is documented well enough to follow.
